before pressure testing Download ExcelDownload PDF **20** Checkpoints **6** Sections Per pipe section/phase QC Engineer, Site Engineer [IS 2065:2015](https://infralens.in/code/IS-2065-1996) [IS 1239:2004](https://infralens.in/code/IS-1239-Part-1-2004) [IS 4985:2016](https://infralens.in/code/IS-4985-2021) Related [📐IS 2065](https://infralens.in/code/IS-2065) [✏️Ceiling Height Bathroom Wc](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/ceiling-height-bathroom-wc) [📘Water-Cement Ratio Guide](https://infralens.in/handbook/water-cement-ratio) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧hazen-williams-pipe-calcula…](https://infralens.in/tools/hazen-williams-pipe-calculator) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A. PIPE MATERIAL & CERTIFICATION | | A1 | Pipe material is certified (ISI mark or equivalent); invoice/certificate matches pipe specifications
Acceptance: ISI mark visible on pipe, test certificate provided, material type matches design drawings, diameter/pressure verified | Cl. 3.1 — Material certification | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A2 | Pipe is not dented, cracked, or deformed; no visible damage or defects
Acceptance: Pipe surface smooth, no dents > 2mm depth, no cracks or discoloration, ISI mark intact | Cl. 4.1 — Physical condition | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A3 | Pipe coating/interior lining intact and free from corrosion (for GI/MS pipes)
Acceptance: GI coating continuous, no rust/pitting visible, internal coating applied if required, no bare metal exposed | Cl. 5.2 — Coating protection | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B. TRENCH PREPARATION & LAYING | | B1 | Trench bottom is firm, leveled, and free from sharp objects; minimum cushioning layer 100 mm sand/gravel provided
Acceptance: Trench bottom compacted (soft spots removed), 100 mm sand cushion layer installed, no sharp stones | Cl. 6.1 — Trench preparation | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B2 | Pipe is laid on sand cushion; gradient/slope is as per design (typically 1:100 to 1:200 for horizontal runs)
Acceptance: Pipe gradient checked with level/theodolite, slope within design range, documented on as-laid drawing | Cl. 6.2 — Gradient design | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B3 | Pipe depth is minimum 0.75 m below finished ground level (to avoid freeze-thaw and surface damage)
Acceptance: Measured depth ≥ 0.75 m from FGL, documented with depths at key points, recorded on as-laid drawing | Cl. 6.3 — Burial depth | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B4 | Pipe spacing from parallel lines maintained: min. 0.3 m from sewerage, 0.5 m from electrical/gas underground
Acceptance: Clearances verified on site with measuring tape, non-crossing layout confirmed, parallel routing ≥ 0.3 m apart | Cl. 7.1 — Service co-ordination | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B5 | Pipe is not laid under/over structures or in corrosive soils without protection (chemical analysis if required)
Acceptance: Layout avoids structures, corrosive soils analyzed if suspected, wrapping/coating applied per requirement | Cl. 7.2 — Environmental protection | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C. PIPE SUPPORT & PROTECTION | | C1 | Support layer (sand + fine gravel) placed over pipe, minimum 150 mm thickness before backfill
Acceptance: Support layer 150 mm thick, compacted properly, free from large stones, even distribution along pipe | Cl. 6.4 — Support layer | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C2 | Backfill material is suitable (soil without stones >50 mm); compacted in layers of 200 mm maximum
Acceptance: Backfill material free from large stones/debris, compacted in 200 mm layers, compaction degree 90% standard Proctor | Cl. 6.5 — Backfill and compaction | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C3 | Above-ground pipe runs protected with insulation jacket (if exposed to sun/temperature); support brackets at 1.5-2.0 m intervals
Acceptance: Insulation jacket applied on exposed runs, UV protection provided, support brackets bolted securely at ≤ 2.0 m spacing | Cl. 8.1 — Above-ground protection | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C4 | In freeze-prone areas, pipe is buried below frost line or insulated (consult local frost depth)
Acceptance: Pipe depth ≥ frost line depth (if applicable), OR thermal insulation applied with R-value per design, documented | Cl. 9.1 — Freeze protection | OK
NC
NA
